flow.name: search-orders-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: search_orders
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that searches orders by optional filter criteria

mcp:tool-listener.name: search_orders
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: search_orders
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers search_orders tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Search orders using optional filter criteria such as status, customerId, orderDate range (dateFrom / dateTo). Returns a list of matching order summaries. All parameters are optional; omitting all returns all orders.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred while searching orders.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract status filter
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional status filter from tool input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract customerId filter
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional customerId filter from tool input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract dateFrom filter
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional dateFrom filter (YYYY-MM-DD) from tool input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract dateTo filter
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional dateTo filter (YYYY-MM-DD) from tool input

ee:transform.doc:name: Filter Orders and Build Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-orders.json, applies all active filters, returns summary list

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allOrders = readUrl("classpath://mock-orders.json", "application/json") var byStatus = if (vars.filterStatus != '') allOrders filter ($.status == vars.filterStatus) else allOrders var byCustomer = if (vars.filterCustomerId != '') byStatus filter ($.customerId == vars.filterCustomerId) else byStatus var byDateFrom = if (vars.filterDateFrom != '') byCustomer filter ($.orderDate >= vars.filterDateFrom) else byCustomer var byDateTo = if (vars.filterDateTo != '') byDateFrom filter ($.orderDate <= vars.filterDateTo) else byDateFrom var results = byDateTo map { orderId: $.orderId, customerId: $.customerId, status: $.status, orderDate: $.orderDate, orderTotal: $.orderTotal } --- { totalResults: sizeOf(results), orders: results }

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] search_orders | status=' ++ (vars.filterStatus default 'ANY') ++ ' | customerId=' ++ (vars.filterCustomerId default 'ANY') ++ ' | results=' ++ (payload.totalResults as String)]
logger.doc:name: Log Search Results
logger.doc:description: Logs search criteria and result count
